title: Series/Episode History - Cannot read properties of null (reading 'name')
body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [x] I have searched the existing open and closed issues

### Current Behavior

Clicking on history for Series (The Rookie) produces error below. Going through history for specific episodes, episode S08E10 (His Name Was Martin) produces the error.

I had to download multiple versions of this episode as a lot of them were not the episode in question, therefore I suspect there's a parsing error with one or more of them as in some of the history entries (as shown below in Trace logs) some had the full media path in the parsing string, while some have just the filename. I may have did a manual import on one or more of them, but I can't actually recall. Sorry.

```
Cannot read properties of null (reading 'name')
  at EpisodeLanguages (webpack://sonarr/frontend/src/Episode/EpisodeLanguages.tsx:28:22)
  at Nh (webpack://sonarr/node_modules/react-dom/cjs/react-dom.production.min.js:160:136)
  at Vk (webpack://sonarr/node_modules/react-dom/cjs/react-dom.production.min.js:289:336)
  at tj (webpack://sonarr/node_modules/react-dom/cjs/react-dom.production.min.js:279:388)
  at tj (webpack://sonarr/node_modules/react-dom/cjs/react-dom.production.min.js:279:319)
  at tj (webpack://sonarr/node_modules/react-dom/cjs/react-dom.production.min.js:279:179)
  at Nk (webpack://sonarr/node_modules/react-dom/cjs/react-dom.production.min.js:270:87)
  at Gk (webpack://sonarr/node_modules/react-dom/cjs/react-dom.production.min.js:267:428)
  at J (webpack://sonarr/node_modules/scheduler/cjs/scheduler.production.min.js:13:202)
  at S (webpack://sonarr/node_modules/scheduler/cjs/scheduler.production.min.js:14:127)
```



### Expected Behavior

History loads for Series/Episode


### Steps To Reproduce

1. Series -> \<series\> -> History
2. Series -> \<series\> -> \<episode\> -> History

### Environment

```markdown
- OS: Unraid 7.2.3
- Sonarr: Sonarr 4.0.17.2952, 4.0.16.2944
- Docker Install: Yes
- Using Reverse Proxy: No
- Browser: Edge 
- Database: Sqlite 3.51.2
```

### What branch are you running?

Main
